decisions.reason: The same source message already has a complete MODIFY requiring historical ticket backfill; the commission-backfill change requires no additional ticket-state change.
The same source message already requires historical commission and ticket backfill in NFT attributes, and the Requirement already covers dynamic metadata.
Backfilling commission accounting in leaderboards and NFT attributes does not change NFT image or media rendering behavior.
Commission backfill and reward totals do not change the rule governing which successfully minted NFTs appear in the dashboard inventory.
The source discusses ticket and commission accounting, not displayed referral counts.
The leaderboard observations concern ticket and commission totals rather than public referral-count statistics.
Historical commission backfill does not alter the next-draw countdown label or its sales-based measure.
The source does not change or question the displayed prize-pool balance.
The statement that twelve mints occurred is used to reconcile rewards and does not change the public mint-counting rule.
The FAQ already states that no-referral mints randomly allocate commissions and tickets; the historical backfill request does not necessarily require a content change.
Reward-accounting backfill does not alter wallet provisioning, custody, access, or wallet contents, and this Requirement is deferred at the source time.
The source does not change mint-confirmation email availability, contents, certificate actions, or link destinations.
